old_problem: The active record requested a broad set of approvals but did not isolate the non-parameterizable blocker. Official RCCL Tests documentation defines multiple simultaneously reported performance values, so the source's unlabeled GB/s ranges do not produce a unique PASS/FAIL verdict.
disposition_reason: Official RCCL Tests documentation confirms that `-g 8` is eight GPUs per thread and the commands test one 1-GiB size, but output includes time, algorithm bandwidth and bus bandwidth for in-place and out-of-place runs. Bus bandwidth also applies a collective-specific factor: all-reduce uses 2*(n-1)/n while all-to-all uses (n-1)/n. The source does not say whether its ranges govern algbw or busbw, in-place or out-of-place, or how 'average/minimum/maximum' is calculated from the default iterations. Selecting one would fabricate the authoritative expected result forbidden by ED-15. Toolchain/topology/safety can be parameterized; this core oracle cannot.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row411 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3003 and adjacent row412 GEMM case.
Applied official RCCL Tests usage: `-b 1G -e 1G` selects a single message size, `-g 8` selects eight GPUs per thread, and default runs expose both in-place and out-of-place results.
Applied official RCCL performance definitions: algbw and busbw are distinct and collective-specific conversion factors differ for all-reduce and all-to-all.
Determined that artifact versions, topology, iterations and safety limits are runtime/project bindings, but the unlabeled numeric band is an irreplaceable acceptance oracle.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row412 and verified its manifest identity; no clone, build, collective or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Eight-GPU RCCL 1-GiB all-reduce and all-to-all bandwidth validation
test_case.purpose: Measure the two distinct eight-GPU RCCL collectives at exactly 1 GiB, verify data correctness and compare the approved output statistic to the source bands without fabric, GPU or host faults.
required_package: Approved ROCm/RCCL and pinned RCCL Tests source commit or verified rocm-systems successor commit with build checksums
Stable eight-GPU UUID/BDF/rank topology and pinned partition mode, RCCL tuning environment and CPU/NUMA binding
Engineering-approved oracle mapping each source band to algbw or busbw, in-place or out-of-place, and exact iteration/statistic aggregation
Approved warmup/iteration count, high-load window, XGMI/PCIe/RAS/thermal/power stops and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After the missing oracle is approved, record repository/ROCm/RCCL/build provenance, GPU UUID/BDF/rank topology and environment. Build the pinned source reproducibly. Run the source-equivalent single-process commands `./build/all_reduce_perf -b 1G -e 1G -g 8 -w <approved_warmups> -n <approved_iterations> -Z csv -x <new_all_reduce.csv>` and `./build/alltoall_perf -b 1G -e 1G -g 8 -w <approved_warmups> -n <approved_iterations> -Z csv -x <new_alltoall.csv>` once each, preserving complete stdout/stderr and synchronized RCCL debug, XGMI/PCIe, RAS, thermal and power evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Both collectives complete correct data checks for all eight mapped ranks at 1 GiB, produce complete in-place/out-of-place algbw and busbw results, and the specifically approved metric/placement/statistic falls within its corresponding source band with no GPU/fabric/RAS/kernel/thermal/power or host fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING: no PASS may be assigned until an owner maps all_reduce 264-309 GB/s (nominal 286) and alltoall 230-286 GB/s (nominal 260) to an exact RCCL Tests output column, memory placement and aggregation formula. Once approved, both independent collectives, correctness checks, band comparisons and health evidence must pass; an average cannot hide an out-of-band required sample or rank.
safety_gate: Do not run against unpinned HEAD; verify compatibility, build flags, partition mode and eight-rank topology
Obtain the signed band-semantic decision before interpreting any bandwidth as PASS
Reserve cooling/power headroom and independent management; preserve pre-test logs and complete outputs
Abort on correctness failure, GPU/rank loss, XGMI/PCIe/RAS/dmesg fault, thermal/power limit, hang or access loss; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Pinned repository/ROCm/RCCL/build provenance and exact environment
Eight-GPU UUID/BDF/rank/NUMA/fabric map and partition mode
Complete all-reduce and all-to-all stdout/stderr, CSV, process status and correctness output
Per-run band calculation plus synchronized fabric/RAS/dmesg/thermal/power evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any collective or platform fault, stop the current process, preserve its first-failure output and telemetry, verify every GPU/rank/link from OS and BMC, restore only approved temporary environment/build changes and escalate. Do not automatically retry or substitute one collective for the other.
